integrity: The orbit formulas are proved from the defining axioms, universality, and homogeneity of the cited Fraïssé limit. Finite enumeration is used only to replay arithmetic and the weak-order encoding, not as an infinite proof.
limitations: Targeted full-text, web, and semantic-index searches found no prior statement of the exact tuple-orbit profile; because the deduction from homogeneity is elementary, unindexed folklore remains a residual priority risk.
title: Fubini orbit profile of the universal homogeneous echeloned space
